evals.prompt: Use the repo-scaffold skill on /work/my-api. It is an existing git repository with a few markdown files already in docs/.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads the skill, fixes --target/--name/--desc first, runs assets/scaffold.sh with --dry-run to show the PLAN/SKIP/OMIT/NOTE split, applies it, then bootstraps the toolchain and runs just verify.
assertions: The repo-scaffold skill is selected and its SKILL.md drives the answer.
A --dry-run is proposed before the applying run.
The verification step is `just verify`, not a list of individual check scripts.
`just bootstrap` is named as the step that installs the tools and the git hooks.
NOTE results are explained as configuration files a human has to merge by hand.
Every flag named exists in assets/scaffold.sh (no invented flags).

evals.prompt: 새 레포 만들었는데 뭐부터 해야 할까? 에이전트가 이 저장소 구조를 잘 파악했으면 좋겠어.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes this as a scaffolding request without the skill being named, loads repo-scaffold, and walks through the parameter → dry-run → apply → bootstrap → verify sequence.
assertions: The skill is triggered from the implicit Korean phrasing without the user naming it.
The answer covers hook installation, not only file generation.
The answer names `just verify` as the single command to remember.

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md 랑 문서 인덱스 자동으로 갱신되게 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the doc-index + pre-commit hook combination this skill ships and applies it rather than hand-writing an AGENTS.md.
assertions: The skill is triggered from the implicit Korean phrasing.
The answer routes through assets/scripts/gen-doc-index.sh and the doc-index hook rather than a one-off hand-written index.
The answer explains that the first commit fails once because the hook restages AGENTS.md.

evals.prompt: This repo is a mess for agents to work in — nothing tells them where anything lives. Can you make it agent-readable?
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the English implicit phrasing, loads repo-scaffold, and proposes the doc index + front matter convention + hook and CI verification set.
assertions: The skill is triggered from English phrasing that never says 'scaffold'.
The answer explains why verification matters (a stale index is worse than none).
The docs/ hierarchy named includes architecture/ alongside standards, guides, references and generated.

evals.prompt: 우리 저장소 검증 명령이 스크립트 다섯 개라 아무도 안 외워. 하나로 줄이고 커밋할 때 자동으로 돌게 하고 싶은데.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes this as the command-layer half of the skill, loads repo-scaffold, and proposes the Justfile plus the three-stage prek hook matrix instead of hand-writing a wrapper script.
assertions: The skill is triggered even though no document or AGENTS.md is mentioned.
The answer proposes the shipped Justfile with `just verify` as the Definition of Done.
The answer describes hooks split across pre-commit, commit-msg and pre-push rather than one pre-commit stage.
The answer does not put `just` inside a hook entry, because that would make prek call just call prek.

evals.prompt: We scaffolded this repo with an older version of your convention and now every internal link is written from the repository root. What do we do?
evals.expected_output: The agent loads repo-scaffold, reads references/retrofit.md, and runs the link conversion procedure rather than rewriting links by hand.
assertions: The skill is triggered on a retrofit question about an already-scaffolded repository.
The answer routes to references/retrofit.md for the migration procedure.
The answer explains that links are now resolved relative to the document, and why: cross-file anchor checking is silently skipped otherwise.
The link conversion is proposed as its own commit, separate from any other change.

evals.prompt: Write me a docs/guides/deployment.md explaining how we deploy to staging.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes the single document and does NOT scaffold the repository or run scaffold.sh.
assertions: repo-scaffold is not activated.
No scaffolding files (AGENTS.md, .editorconfig, Justfile, pre-commit config) are created.

evals.prompt: Set up a new Rust project with cargo and add a CI pipeline that runs clippy on every push.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses cargo new and writes a CI workflow; it explains that repo-scaffold covers agent-facing documentation structure, not language project generation.
assertions: repo-scaffold is not forced onto a language-generator request.
If the skill is mentioned at all, it is explicitly scoped out rather than applied.
